programme.title: Vanity Flaw
programme.desc: Mallory is a young ambitious woman with dreams of becoming a successful dance choreographer in the industry. Being a risk taker, Mallory decides to dance at a strip club for one night after losing a dare, only to be captured by an obsessive man with a fetish for strippers and violence.

programme.title: Murder Gardens
programme.desc: Murder Gardens is the story of Chase Washington, a 19-year-old young man whose world has been turned upside down after he leaves a comfortable home provided by his foster father for a life of crime and corruption that he's introduced to by his older brother Rell Washington. Chase ends up in the middle of a war between a notorious crew of drug dealers, corrupt politicians and local law enforcement. Determined to survive and prove that the brain is mightier than the gun, Chase finds a way to outsmart his new found enemies and keep him and his brother Rell out of prison and a graveyard.

programme.title: The Perfect Challenge
programme.desc: Alfred & Della Hughes, a successful couple, face marital strife. Alfred's neglect and an affair strain their bond. Della, overwhelmed by household duties, feels undervalued. Their children witness their parents' escalating conflicts, leading to a tumultuous breakdown. Though their children plead for unity, divorce looms. A family intervention, sparked by a heartfelt gift, forces them to confront their deep-seated love and the possibility of reconciliation.

programme.title: Don Dada
programme.desc: Desperate to survive a brutal Chicago winter, Rah Jah and Tee Tee hustle for food and shelter in the streets. When a botched deal lands him in the hands of powerful crime bosses, he rises to the top of the hierarchy at a deadly cost.

programme.title: Commandments of a Female Hustler
programme.desc: Three childhood friends, Lala, Binky, and Jay grew up together on the streets of East Baltimore. Wanting a better life for themselves, they learn the ways of hustling. When they align themselves with one of the most powerful drug dealers in the game, their loyalties are tested, and the very commandments that once bound them start to break.

programme.title: Heart of a Woman
programme.desc: Alisha, a rising model with a bright future, chose to put her career on hold to stand by her football star husband Jax. When an opportunity arises for her to return to the runway, their marriage is put to the test, and whether love or career holds the most weight in their relationship.

programme.title: The Agony and the Ecstasy
programme.desc: When rival gangster Derrick Smith is released from prison, the beef with Armand Rossi explodes into an all-out war in Fountain City, MO. After a hit on his family , Armand goes into killer mode. Derrick and Vic Moore team up for revenge , but Rossi and his partner Qua stay ahead. When they involve Dr. Monica Gaye in the plot , she flips the script to survive. A devastating loss sends a grieving Armand past the point of no return , forcing him to eliminate every one of his opps.

programme.title: South Side Hero
programme.desc: After serving a 10-year sentence on a RICO charge, reformed gangster Tommy ‘Ace’ Crown returns home to find his 15-year old daughter Sierra missing after she ran away with a man she met online. When the police decline to help, Ace is determined to track her down himself.

programme.title: The Undeserving
programme.desc: Harper, a cold-blooded assassin, botches a hit on the wrong target. Hunted by her employer, she's forced to confront her past trauma. Follow her descent into darkness as she tries to survive and escape the consequences of her actions.

programme.title: The Offer
programme.desc: When Devin and Imani—an estranged couple drowning under financial pressure—receive an unmarked briefcase containing a life-changing sum of money, they find themselves faced with an impossible decision. As tensions rise, secrets unravel, and old wounds reopen, the couple begins to fracture under the moral and emotional weight of the offer.

programme.title: Blind Tiez
programme.desc: Naire is on the up and up as he’s recently promoted to be the youngest detective in the police department. When one of his cases goes completely wrong, he stands accused of murder, and must race to clear his name.

programme.title: Contusion
programme.desc: Terry and his grandmother enjoy a life of peace and harmony, until one night when a group of thieves invade their home. As he navigates from the aftermath, he must confront whether justice will prevail or whether darkness will consume everything he holds dear.

programme.title: Don't Push That
programme.desc: Three friends who all work together at a local video store stumble upon a mysterious device labeled “DPT” which has a mysterious function: predicting the absolute worst possible outcome of any moment or decision. Once the button on the device is pressed, the action can’t be undone, and it must be repeated every 11 minutes to prevent further destruction. The results are equally fun and chaotic.

programme.title: Broken Buckets
programme.desc: After serving 17 years in prison, Travis Cane returns home to rebuild his life and reconnect with his family. But his once bright son, Dontae is acting out and abandoned his goals in basketball for a life on the streets. Hoping to repair their relationship, they work out their struggles on the court.

programme.title: My Killer Ex Girlfriend
programme.desc: Jocelyn, a possessive romantic, is infatuated with Eric. When he breaks up with her due to her overbearing nature, she refuses to let go. Now, Eric and his new girlfriend, Candice, must escape Jocelyn's vengeful rage. Can they survive?

programme.title: Melted Lipstick
programme.desc: Riley Davis, a young woman in her twenties, who navigates through life fraught with insecurities about her body, self-esteem issues. Her life takes a mystical turn when she encounters an enigmatic voodoo doctor who gifts her a special lipstick, claiming that it holds the power to transform her into anyone she desires when applied. However, Riley soon learn that all magic comes for a price, as she goes down a dangerous and deadly path of destruction.

programme.title: Nothing Even Matters
programme.desc: Paroled after 5 years for a victimless crime, Travis is taken in by an acquaintance, Benny, and her mother. Their generosity turns into a life of crime and murder. As he falls for a woman named Bear, Travis must escape the web of secrets and lies he's trapped in, fighting for survival and the love he's found.

programme.title: The One That Got Away
programme.desc: Blake, a man on the verge of marriage who becomes ensnared in a dangerous game of deception and revenge orchestrated by his vengeful ex, London. As their past resurfaces, he is forced to confront hidden secrets and navigate London's sinister manipulations, leading to explosive confrontations and heart-pounding suspense.

programme.title: Priceless: The Dawn
programme.desc: Having platinum records and superstar rosters seem like easy work to music industry legends Donica Blair and Shequell Harris, but when they want to start their own label, they become targets in more ways than they are prepared for. Adding Seven to the mix in an already uneven playing field leads to unorthodox measures to protect Don and save her life. Quell, on the other hand, may have gotten exactly what she asked for when she calls Silk to help them out.

programme.title: Priceless: The Score
programme.desc: After starting their new record label, Donica Blair and Shequell Harris have entered a dangerous arena full of guns, lies, and deceit. Now they are racing against time to right their wrongs and save their own lives before they are next in a string of murders. Meanwhile their partner Seven, has fallen victim to the deadliest of them all; the Black widow.

programme.title: Blood in the Comments
programme.desc: Azariyah, a rising content creator and self-proclaimed relationship expert has routine live event online discussing relationships and creating content. When Danica reaches out to her about her boyfriend’s sexuality, Azariyah suggests she confronts him, which leads to Danica taking her own life. Haunted by the guilt, Azariyah searches for the truth amidst a wave of threats and online violence.

programme.title: Risk it All
programme.desc: Sierra, a gifted but overlooked painter, struggles to balance her artistic dreams with the reality of a stable life alongside her devoted but practical husband, Marcus. When a powerful and seductive art collector offers her the recognition she’s always craved, Sierra is drawn into a world where ambition blurs moral lines and desire turns dangerous. As passion, obsession, and betrayal collide, she must decide how much she’s truly willing to sacrifice to be seen.

programme.title: The Miracle of Tonya Pinkins
programme.desc: A musical biographical documentary about the life, times and career of Tony Award winner and Broadway performing star Tonya Pinkins (Jelly’s Last Jam, Play On, Caroline or Change) the movie chronicles her beginning as a professional child actress in Chicago to an award winning Broadway star, along with the stories and songs that made her one of America’s top performing artists.

programme.title: Till Lies Do Us Part
programme.desc: Amina and Alex announce their engagement to their family and friends after only dating for six months, and are having a destination wedding at that. As the romantic and loving getaway goes along, betrayals and hidden truths come to the surface causing chaos and drama.

programme.title: If I Can't Have You
programme.desc: Marc, a married man embarks on an affair with the seductive and enigmatic Marissa, that quickly turns into a nightmare. Lust quickly evolves into obsession when she realizes that Marc will never leave his wife. Marissa embarks on a deadly campaign of jealousy and deceit, leaving only destruction in her wake following the mantra "If I can't have you, no one else can." Marc must protect his family, while also confronting the darkest corners of his past that will define the course of his life.

programme.title: The Last Days of an Escort
programme.desc: Kitty, a struggling escort, agrees to be documented for a film. Her roommate, Star, a more successful escort, reluctantly joins. A new client, Earl, changes their lives forever when he asks to see Kitty and Star together. Kitty's world becomes increasingly dangerous as she navigates the dark underworld of escorting.

programme.title: The Hit List
programme.desc: Marcus is a ladies’ man until he meets Nia, the woman of his dreams. However, Nia’s brother has a psychic ability that threatens to expose Marcus as the player he is, leading him to extreme measures with deadly consequences.

programme.title: Garrett Morris and Michael Schultz
programme.desc: The story of the careers of legendary actor Garrett Morrison and legendary movie director Michael Schultz. Follow their life and career from their early beginnings to adulthood and becoming worldwide legendary artists from Broadway to Hollywood.

programme.title: Single Black Female
programme.desc: Rose is a young college freshman who meets her roommate Max for the first time. The two develop an intense bond, and Max is willing to prove her loyalty to Rose, even if it means someone will have to die if they get in the way.

programme.title: Nowhere to be Found
programme.desc: Two sisters go on a senior trip to Mexico, led by Ava’s boyfriend Trent. Meanwhile, journalist Jessica Vandross is going to the same Mexican town in search of her sister’s killer after escaping a sex trafficking ring. These stories collide, in a thrilling fight for their lives.

programme.title: Somebody's Got to Die
programme.desc: After leading a life of contract killing, Jake makes a promise to his fiancé, Nicole, to go on the straight and narrow. He finds solace in running a bar with his brother Kelvin. When his former Kingpin Marcel offers him a way out, he is forced to confront shadows of his past, and overcome one of the biggest jobs of his criminal career.

programme.title: Betrayal at First Hand
programme.desc: After her friend Monica betrays her by sleeping with Big D, Sarah's grief quickly spirals into madness. However, her breakdown is accelerated by a shocking twist and only Big D knows the truth. He must reveal the crime to Sarah, hoping that unveiling one horrific truth can redeem him and save the woman he lost.

programme.title: Too Little Too Late
programme.desc: James “Honcho” Young II is a well-respected boss but his position is threatened by his ex-love, turned partner, Ryan “Rain” Mills who desperately wants to be next in line. Driven by jealousy, love and money, Rain sets her sights on taking what’s hers, causing Honcho to lose more than just his position. Can she afford the cost to be boss?

programme.title: Quiet as Kept
programme.desc: Jay is unlawfully detained. His ex-girlfriend returns, and his business partners work to clear his name. Meanwhile, a crooked cop is under suspicion for murder, and connections are made between him and Jay. Torn between duty and loyalty, Detective Johnson is caught in the middle. As the prosecution struggles, Jay and his business partners work to exist the dangerous world cleanly.

programme.title: Murder on the Blade
programme.desc: Tobin, a young man with a troubled childhood is currently working through his trauma with a professional counselor. Meanwhile, there is a serial killer on the loose targeting sex workers, and several clues are pointing to both him and his troubled relationship with his mother.

programme.title: Deliveries From Eva
programme.desc: Disgraced music star Reese is surprised to learn that he still has a fan in the form of delivery driver, Eva. The two form an unlikely friendship that begins to sour due to Eva's growing obsession and her struggles with PTSD.

programme.title: Kill For You
programme.desc: Suga, a devoted mother, finds herself opening up to love again when she begins a relationship with Danny, a man who seems genuine and caring. But their connection is quickly tested when she is introduced to Danny’s father, Rusty—a man whose deeply rooted racism creates an undercurrent of tension that can’t be ignored. As Suga tries to navigate the relationship while protecting her son, she begins to sense that something isn’t right beneath the surface.

programme.title: What I'd Do For Love
programme.desc: Greer Patterson’s happy marriage falls apart when she discovers her husband’s infidelity. After exacting bitter revenge, she’s back on the market looking for love, and anyone standing in her way will see just how far she’ll go.

programme.title: The Groomsman
programme.desc: A co-ed bachelor and bachelorette getaway at a secluded Airbnb spirals into a night of fear and suspicion when Savanna’s former love unexpectedly arrives as a groomsman in her upcoming wedding to Bryce. As tensions rise and unsettling events begin to unfold, it becomes clear that someone is manipulating the group from the shadows.
